## What

Describe the change in one or two sentences.

## Why

What problem does this solve, or what value does it add?

## How

Briefly explain the implementation and how you tested it.

## Checklist

- [ ] I tested the change locally.
- [ ] Links point to appropriate original sources.
- [ ] I did not add a duplicate tool or source.
- [ ] I checked English/Arabic copy when relevant.
- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated refactors.
